title: Extract Store into its Own Technology
description: Extract/Extend/Refactor store into its own technology. Store is a local-first, non-blocking, client-side, in-memory store (currently the DocumentVcsStore/Backbone/BlobStore/Studio regions inside vcs/rs/lib.rs). All backbones (file, folder, remote) are hot-swappable at runtime to store. Ensure it works cleanly with vcs (version-graph algebra), pack+dsl (serialization), protocol+op (op algebra), and hub+db (server). Full facade: apps depend on store, never vcs directly; dsl derive macros flip ::vcs:: -> ::store::. Also rename the colliding compose/client/bin/store sidecar to compose-gql.
